question: Can interrupting long Prompt activation transfers only on slow physical links improve C1 multi-cluster Decode tail latency on the validated sparse DAG while preserving throughput and GPU efficiency?
disclosure: Fixed-size Prompt transfer chunking and Decode prioritization are related to MoLink and are not claimed as independently novel. This experiment tests whether topology-selective application is useful jointly with sparse path admission.
primary_comparison: chunk_slow versus gate on paired seeds and traces
secondary_comparison: chunk_slow versus chunk_all; report relative endpoints and number of transfer pauses, regardless of primary decision
if_fail: Preserve the negative result and stop this candidate; do not adjust chunk size or gate margins on these seeds.
if_pass: Freeze an independent 1800-second held-out comparison against both gate and chunk_all.
